description: Configuring Salesforce Email-to-Case: Standard vs On-Demand mode selection, routing address setup, email threading via Lightning tokens, auto-response rules, attachment limits, and per-address case field defaults. Trigger keywords: email-to-case, routing address, on-demand email-to-case, email threading, case from email, email agent, routing address setup, Case.settings-meta.xml, EmailToCaseRoutingAddress, emailServicesAddress, isVerified, caseOrigin, enableThreadTokenInBody, useEmailHeadersForThreading, overEmailLimitAction, unauthorizedSenderAction, enableE2CAttachmentAsFile, saveEmailHeaders, newEntityRecordType, casePriority, EmailMessage.EmailRoutingAddressId, auto-response loop. NOT for the wider case layer (queues, escalation rules, case teams, entitlements) - use admin/case-management-setup. NOT for routing case work items to agents after creation - use admin/omni-channel-routing-setup. NOT for the email templates or letterheads themselves - use admin/email-templates-and-alerts.
inputs: Service Cloud org with Cases enabled
Decision on Email-to-Case mode: On-Demand (recommended) or Standard (requires local agent)
Inbound email address(es) to map to cases (e.g., support@company.com)
Case field defaults per routing address: origin, status, priority, queue or owner
Whether auto-response emails are required on case creation
name: email-to-case-configuration
official_sources: Salesforce Help: Email-to-Case Limits and Limitations — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.email_to_case_limits.htm

Salesforce Help (KB 000386265): Attachment size limit for On-Demand Email-to-Case — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=000386265&type=1 — 35 MB total redirected message (body + attachments + HTML); up to 33% MIME encoding inflation, giving an effective attachment ceiling of ~25 MB; 25 MB was the total before Winter '21 and 10 MB before Summer '14

Metadata API Developer Guide, `CaseSettings` → `EmailToCaseSettings` (PDF v62) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf — the element names and enums used throughout `references/metadata-examples.md`: `enableEmailToCase` (and the note that it can't be disabled once on), `enableOnDemandEmailToCase`, `enableE2CAttachmentAsFile`, `enableE2CDeduplicateAttachments`, `enableE2CSourceTracking`, the two mutually exclusive threading pairs (`enableThreadTokenInBody/Subject` for Lightning Threading, `enableThreadIDInBody/Subject` for orgs without it), `useEmailHeadersForThreading`, `notifyOwnerOnNewCaseEmail`, `preQuoteSignature`, and the `EmailToCaseOnFailureActionType` values behind `overEmailLimitAction` (Bounce/Discard/Requeue) and `unauthorizedSenderAction` (Bounce/Discard) — gotchas 8, 9, 10, 11

Metadata API Developer Guide, `CaseSettings` → `EmailToCaseRoutingAddress` (PDF v62) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf — the per-address fields and the two behaviours that drive gotchas 6, 7, 12 and 13: `caseOwner` "sets a value of `defaultCaseOwner` in `CaseSettings`", `routingAddresses` "Removing an address from this list deletes it from the target org", `emailServicesAddress` and `isVerified` are read-only, `saveEmailHeaders`, `authorizedSenders`, `createTask` / `taskStatus`, `addressType` (EmailToCase / Outlook), `isPermsetControlled` (API 61.0+), `routingFlow` and `fallbackQueue` (API 56.0+), `newEntityRecordType` (api_meta L112078 — no version note and no value format, which is the grounding for the UNVERIFIED markers in gotcha 14), and `casePriority` (api_meta L112039 — "Specifies the default case priority", carrying no Required marker, which is the grounding for the UNVERIFIED marker in gotcha 15). The guide's own sample definition sets `casePriority` on both of its routing addresses (api_meta L112187, L112200)

Metadata API Developer Guide, `CaseSettings` Declarative Metadata Sample Definition and package manifest (PDF v62) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf — the shape the `Case.settings-meta.xml` example in `references/metadata-examples.md` is built from, the `Settings` / `Case` manifest member, and the statement that the `*` wildcard "applies only when retrieving all settings, not for an individual setting"

Object Reference for the Salesforce Platform, `EmailMessage` (PDF v62) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf — the verification queries and gotcha 8: `ParentId` ("ID of the case that's associated with the email"), `Incoming`, `Headers` ("The Internet message headers of the incoming email … Doesn't apply to outgoing emails"), `EmailRoutingAddressId` ("set when the email is processed by Email-to-Case service"), `ValidatedFromAddress`, and `ThreadIdentifier` — "This field is not used by On-Demand Email-to-Case"

Object Reference for the Salesforce Platform, `Case` and `EmailRoutingAddress` (PDF v62) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf — that `Case.Origin` is the field `caseOrigin` populates, that the Case field list contains no routing-address field (`Case.SourceId` is "The ID of the social post source"), that `Case.SuppliedEmail` is what ties duplicate cases in a loop back to one sender, and that `EmailRoutingAddress` (`PersonalName`, `Address`, `EmailServicesAddress`) is admin-only and requires Email-to-Case to be enabled

Live org validation (dry-run `sf project deploy validate`, `checkOnly`, API 67.0, 2026-09-12) — the source for gotchas 14 and 15, each marked UNVERIFIED against the guide because the guide is silent: `Property 'newEntityRecordType' not valid in version 63.0` (rejected at 62.0 and 63.0, accepted at 64.0), `In field: newEntityRecordType - no RecordType named Support found` for a bare developer name where `Case.Support` resolves, and `EmailToCaseRoutingAddress[support@acme.example]: Missing casePriority` for an address with no `casePriority`. Org behaviour is not an official source; it is recorded here as the evidence behind three checker rules (`E2C-RT-01`, `E2C-RT-02`, `E2C-PRI-01`) and re-checked against the guide before either claim is treated as permanent

Salesforce Developer Limits and Allocations Quick Reference (App Limits Cheat Sheet, PDF v62) — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_app_limits_cheatsheet.pdf — checked for a daily Email-to-Case limit and an inbound size limit; it contains neither. The only adjacent figure is "Email services heap size is 50 MB". This is the grounding for the UNVERIFIED marker on the daily limit in gotcha 9 — the number must be read from the org, not quoted
outputs: Enabled Email-to-Case feature with On-Demand mode configured
One or more verified routing addresses mapped to inbound support mailboxes
Mail server forward rule directing inbound mail to Salesforce routing address
Email threading tested end-to-end (reply threads into parent case)
Auto-response rule firing correctly when assignment rule fires
Per-address intake record type (newEntityRecordType) on an API 64.0+ manifest
